event_records.description: The rail franchise bill is referred to the parliamentary transport committee, starting the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing.

parliamentary_transport_committee.name: Parliamentary Transport Committee
parliamentary_transport_committee.persona_brief:
You are Parliamentary Transport Committee.
The committee is responsible for reviewing transport-related legislation. Its rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The committee has discretion over scheduling and may consider political factors, workload, and public interest.

resolution.question: Will the Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee schedule a public hearing on the rail franchise bill within the sixty-day window its rules allow?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the parliamentary transport committee actually scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill before 2026-09-30T09:00:00+03:00 (sixty days after referral). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00.
